images.en: Take a little wonder along the way.
There is no hurry in a beautiful afternoon.
Make room for the small joys.
images.zh: 给小小的欢喜，留一点位置。

images.en: Every path has its own gentle rhythm.
images.zh: 每条路，都有自己的温柔节奏。

images.en: Let simple days become good memories.
images.zh: 让简单的日子，成为好回忆。

images.en: Some beauty asks only that we notice.
